segment.target: These are the mutants from Depot A area. I'm researching their mutations.<end>

segment.source: What happened to these people?<end>
segment.target: What happened to these people?<end>

segment.target: They once lived in the Depot A, or the Old Junkyard as they call it. At one time in the past they were exposed to powerful mutagen.<end>

segment.source: Who did this? Who exposed them to mutagen?<end>

segment.target: I don't know - maybe the old Biocorp. It happened way before my time, more than a hundred years ago.<end>

segment.source: You stay right there and be quiet now. I'm keeping my eye on you.<end>

segment.target: Catch you later, doc.<end>
